meta.title: Freally Products: desktop apps for producers and creators
hero.tagline: Desktop apps for producers and creators.
hero.lede: Eight apps for Windows, macOS and Linux: four for making music, and four for the work around it. They run on your own computer, look like one family and speak eighteen languages.
products.title: The apps
products.midiMaster: Artist-accurate MIDI, generated in your DAW, in your project's own key and tempo.
products.flipcopy: A copy machine for your clips: audio in, MIDI out; MIDI in, audio out.
products.oscillate: A DAW where four producers work in the same session at once.
products.unloop: Turns an 8-bar loop into a finished, arranged record.
products.sourcerer: One search for every file, on every OS.
products.fileManager: Copy, move, sync and verify files, byte for byte.
products.teleprompt: A teleprompter that reads at a real human pace.
products.capture: Record and stream like a studio, straight from your machine.
about.title: About Freally
about.p1: Freally Products makes desktop software for people who make things: producers, musicians, streamers, presenters, and anyone with a lot of files. Every app is built to do its one job well, on your own computer, without getting in your way.
about.p2: The apps are made by Mike Weaver, and they share one design, one set of controls and one way of being honest about what they do.
principles.desktop.title: On your computer
principles.desktop.body: Real desktop apps for Windows, macOS and Linux, not a website you rent.
principles.honest.title: Honest about what's done
principles.honest.body: Each app's site says what works today, what doesn't yet, and where other tools do better.
principles.languages.title: Eighteen languages
principles.languages.body: Every app and every site, in the same eighteen languages.
principles.free.title: Free today
principles.free.body: Free today, with no paid tiers. Future versions may be sold, and the sites will say so first.
downloads.title: Downloads
downloads.body: There are no downloads yet. Each app's own site shows where it is on its road to 1.0, and that's where its downloads will be.
footer.rights: © 2026 Mike Weaver. All Rights Reserved. Free today; future versions may be sold.
hero.notice: Free today. Every Freally app is free today, but it might not be free forever: future versions may be sold.
